text: The Wrestler is a cosmic grappler who never taps out. He trains in nebulae, pins FUD, and escapes those selling the move on his way to Andromeda.

Wrestlers are tenacious, hard-working, no-nonsense, tough SOBs. The Programme keeps the score the same way a wrestling room does: live numbers, hold times on the wall, losses posted where everyone can see them.
$WRESTLER is paired with $GLXY on Robinhood Chain. Two cards, one arena — the grappler and the galaxy.
He never taps out. He pins the chart. His only weakness is paper hands.
$RUGPULL waits in the ring. The Grind Squad buys weekly and never talks about it. The Takedown Crew adds on every red day. The Scramble Group moves in and out of position.
Tonight in the Galaxy Arena. Commissioner Galaxy presides. The galaxy contracts… then EXPANDS.
